description: AstroYield là 1 nhóm 5 thành viên làm về đề tài nông nghiệp, không yêu cầu cao về kỹ năng, chỉ cần biết sử dụng AI nhưng phải có trách nhiệm làm việc và hòa đồng:D
summary:
Field-Shift (AstroYield) is an interactive geospatial web platform designed to evaluate agricultural crop suitability and optimize farming resilience under changing climate conditions. Built with Node.js, Express, and dynamic heatmap visualization, the application integrates NASA Earth observation and climate datasets with real-time geocoding to analyze land coordinates while automatically filtering out oceans and water bodies.

To address agricultural adaptation challenges, Field-Shift combines multi-factor crop suitability scoring, environmental risk alerts, and trade-and-transport logistics modeling. Additionally, it incorporates a Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) module to solve complex crop-allocation and supply-chain trade-offs across regions. Users can visually explore suitability heatmaps, assess localized climate risks, and identify optimal crop distribution strategies.

This solution is vital because shifting weather patterns and supply-chain disruptions increasingly threaten global food security. By translating raw satellite data into actionable planting, risk-mitigation, and logistics insights, Field-Shift empowers farmers, researchers, and policymakers to maximize agricultural yield sustainably and adapt proactively to environmental change.
details: FieldShift is an interactive web platform built with JavaScript, Node.js, Express, HTML/CSS, and Python that helps farmers and agricultural planners adapt crop selection to climate change using NASA Earth observation data. When a user selects any coordinate on the map, the system automatically filters out water bodies to focus on arable land while analyzing temperature and solar radiation from NASA POWER, surface and root-zone soil moisture from NASA SMAP/Crop-CASMA, precipitation and flood/erosion risks from NASA GPM IMERG, heat stress and evapotranspiration from NASA ECOSTRESS and MODIS LST, and vegetation health and soil fertility from MODIS NDVI and SoilGrids alongside interpolated climate heatmaps (climate-grid.json). Creatively bridging agronomy with economics and logistics, FieldShift matches crop ecological thresholds and FAO CROPGRIDS distributions against live market prices from NextFarm API, global trade flows from UN Comtrade, regional Vietnamese agro-economic datasets, and real-time road routing to nearby collection hubs via OpenStreetMap Overpass API and OpenRouteService. Designed by carefully weighing multi-dimensional climate stressors, market profitability, and lightweight performance for rural bandwidth, the platform turns complex satellite data into clear suitability scores and charts that reduce crop failure risks, optimize resource use, protect rural livelihoods, and strengthen food security.
